summary: You never asked: On election day {neighbor} tells you she will vote for you, though you never asked.
realLife: He lost his first race, for the Cambridge council, as a college student. A neighbor told him she voted for him though he never asked, and that people like to be asked.
gates: Your canvassing skipped your own street or precinct.
choices: thank her and ask for her vote now

branches.then: She says she voted for the other candidate because they came to her door.

branches.when: a parent who once worked a precinct
branches.then: After a loss, they say you lost your own neighborhood, and your answer decides whether the next campaign starts at home.

branches.when: you did knock on her door
branches.then: The scene does not play. She waves on her way in.
